description: Resolve a WGS84 point to the Nigerian state, LGA and (where mapped) ward containing it — the reverse-geocode primitive other lookups compose on. Example: { lat: 6.43, lng: 3.42 }. Data: GRID3, CC BY 4.0.
name: point_in_admin

lga.description: Local Government Area (ADM2) containing the point

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

ward.description: Ward (ADM3) containing the point, where mapped

title: Reverse-geocode a point to admin areas
